request: Allow choosing countries inside Atsumi without downloading a config for every switch; research regional accessibility of Arca Live, FANZA and comparable sites.

audit.inaccessible: Carry forward previous explicitly inaccessible/deleted source limitations.

decisions: Provider manual WireGuard keys can be reused, but current official server catalogue requires VPN-authenticated scope; anonymous calls explicitly refused. Do not extract Chrome cookies or bypass account access; do not use unverified third-party public keys.

Implement encrypted saved-country profile collection. One initial config import per desired server/country, then selection inside app reconnects immediately if VPN enabled; off selection stays off. Keep original vpn.dpapi and migrate on first collection write.
Only metadata (id/name/country hint) reaches frontend, never keys/config. Actual exit country/IP remains authoritative; filename country is only a label.
Country selection, config imports and switches serialize and reject browser downloads; transitions fail closed and preserve main app recordings/downloads/global network.
Existing profile is retained; import adds countries without overwriting others or disconnecting an active profile.
Use consistent 40px controls/readable dark UI; guide explains initial per-country setup and no repeat download thereafter.
No account credential generation without action-time confirmation. No app account setting changes, purchases, likes/bookmarks, release, commit or PC shutdown.
acceptance: UI country switching on/off, import and download lock tests
Actual Japan and another approved country connection; preserve original key and compare system network settings
Country recommendations distinguish official region policy from unverified VPN success
